title: Arcana Splat2Mesh launch: 3DGS PLY to OBJ/GLB (Japanese)

author.name: Arcana Mfg.Co.,Ltd. | 株式会社Arcana製作所

summary: Arcana Mfg announces Splat2Mesh v1.0 converting 3D Gaussian Splatting PLY files to OBJ/GLB locally with free personal non-commercial use. Launch tweet quotes a teaser video showing the v1.0 UI loading MipNeRF360 bicycle.ply.
question_it_answers: What does Arcana Splat2Mesh convert and what license terms apply at launch?

claims.text: Splat2Mesh converts 3DGS data to OBJ/GLB; personal non-commercial use is free.
claims.evidence:
3D Gaussian SplattingデータをOBJ / GLB形式へ変換できます。
